|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Adds 2 to maneuver of any starfighter he pilots. Your total ability here may not be reduced. Once per game, may lose 1 Force to deploy a droid from Lost Pile. During battle, may target a just-hit character. Target's forfeit is restored to normal.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 of [[Chewbacca, Walking Carpet]] (version 4 of 4); it is the current text. The image is the Players Committee card image, which prints this text. Versions in date order: [[Chewbacca, Walking Carpet]] (original, release sheet of 11 May 2012); [[Chewbacca, Walking Carpet (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Chewbacca, Walking Carpet (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original); '''this page''' (PC-E3, Players Committee card image, uploaded 7 May 2013, the same words as the original, the current text). The Master List of 27 April 2013 ([[Chewbacca, Walking Carpet (Errata 2)]]) has the same words; the card image is current only because it was uploaded later, on its server's bulk upload date, which is the only date known for it.
* '''Original''' ([[Chewbacca, Walking Carpet]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 July 2012), page 5, slip 26 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Adds 2 to maneuver of any starfighter he pilots. Your total ability here may not be reduced. Once per game, may lose 1 Force to deploy a droid from Lost Pile. During battle, may target a just-hit character. Target's forfeit is restored to normal.” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-chewbaccawalkingcarpet-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-02-Chewbacca_Walking_Carpet.png]]) print it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 5) prints this text again, identical character for character (pilot icon, “Force”, “may target a just-hit character”). Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E2 ([[Chewbacca, Walking Carpet (Errata 2)]]); the current text is the PC card image uploaded on 7 May 2013 ([[Chewbacca, Walking Carpet (Errata 3)]], the same words).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=5, page 5. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Chewbacca, Walking Carpet (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) wrote the pilot icon out (“Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots.”), changed “lose 1 Force” to “lose 1 force”, dropped “may” (“During battle, target”) and the hyphen (“a just hit character”)<ref name="cl-1281_26-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); the same text in the captures of 12 December 2012 and 11 January 2013</ref>: “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Adds 2 to maneuver of any starfighter he pilots. Your total ability here may not be reduced. Once per game, may lose 1 force to deploy a droid from Lost Pile. During battle, target a just hit character. Target's forfeit is restored to normal.” No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-02-Chewbacca_Walking_Carpet-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]). The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Chewbacca, Walking Carpet (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 5)<ref name="ml-ls" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Chewbacca, Walking Carpet]]) again, word for word: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Adds 2 to maneuver of any starfighter he pilots. Your total ability here may not be reduced. Once per game, may lose 1 Force to deploy a droid from Lost Pile. During battle, may target a just-hit character. Target's forfeit is restored to normal.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text); the PC card image uploaded later (this page) is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1281-26-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip and the PC card image.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-chewbaccawalkingcarpet-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Chewbacca, Walking Carpet]]) again, word for word: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Adds 2 to maneuver of any starfighter he pilots. Your total ability here may not be reduced. Once per game, may lose 1 Force to deploy a droid from Lost Pile. During battle, may target a just-hit character. Target's forfeit is restored to normal.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual8-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 7 May 2013, 13:52<ref name="pcdir-Virtual8-Light">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034752/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). Uploaded after the Master List, it is the latest version and so the current text. The PC card image prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip.
